fit.label: Job 1
fit.title: Principal Backend Engineer
fit.sample_note: Sample job description written for this demo, not a real posting.
fit.description: Sample Co. is hiring a Principal Backend Engineer to own the design and reliability of our core platform. You will build and scale event-driven services in Go and Python on AWS Lambda, keep cold starts and costs down, make them safe to retry, own them end to end including on-call and observability, lead projects across teams and mentor engineers. Experience with LLM tooling (MCP, RAG, evals) is a plus.

questions.q: What has the candidate owned end to end, including on-call?
Walk me through an event-driven pipeline the candidate built on AWS Lambda, and how much traffic it handled.
How did the candidate deal with Lambda cold starts and concurrency limits?
How does the candidate keep retries from processing the same event twice?
How does the candidate monitor a service and get alerted when it breaks?
Tell me about a time the candidate got several teams to agree on a change.
What kind of team does the candidate want to join next?

role_facts: Yes: the headcount is approved and funded, and we're interviewing this month.
The team reads every screening report within two days.
